title.narrative: Distribution of School Supplies & Data collection in schools in Haiti

description.narrative: Technical support in the collection of data to verify the performance indicators of the school subsidy program with 250 non-public schools and in the collection of data for the quality assurance system with 100 public schools distributed in the departments of Artibonite, Centre, West, North, North-West and North-East. UNOPS will also have to distribute school materials in about 100 public schools distributed in the geographical departments concerned.
